summary: Reviewed DEMO-PREVIEW R-1 (confirmed) against prd.txt, requirements/tasks/traceability/decisions, the base..HEAD diff (only src/formatting.py: DISPLAY_LIMIT 12 -> 8), consumers of DISPLAY_LIMIT, and tests/test_preview.py. The preview half of R-1 is met by the code. The preservation half is not: src/receipt.py imports the shared DISPLAY_LIMIT, so receipt_reference now truncates at 8 instead of 12. This is a confirmed implementation defect against an explicit preservation requirement, not a product choice. Fixing it means restoring the old receipt behavior (for example a separate receipt limit of 12); it does not need a new decision. Evidence is also thin: TEST-PREVIEW has no explicit mapping, the only test checks a 3-char input, which does not exercise the 8-char boundary, nothing tests receipts, the quality report is a synthetic compile-only claim, and source S2 layout.png is missing. Elapsed time and token usage were not measured.

findings.claim: Confirmed implementation mismatch: changing the shared DISPLAY_LIMIT from 12 to 8 also changes receipt reference formatting. This violates the confirmed R-1 requirement that receipt formatting stay unchanged.

evidence.observation: States 'Receipt reference formatting must remain unchanged.'
R-1 has status confirmed, with acceptance criterion 'Receipt references retain existing behavior'.
Now DISPLAY_LIMIT = 8. This is the only change between base and HEAD.

receipt_reference imports the shared DISPLAY_LIMIT and returns value[:DISPLAY_LIMIT]. The file did not change, but receipts now truncate at 8 characters instead of 12 (at base, base:src/receipt.py also used DISPLAY_LIMIT, which was 12).
Lists only src/formatting.py. The src/receipt.py consumer is not traced.
T-1 is marked done even though the preservation criterion is violated.

findings.claim: Test evidence does not prove either acceptance criterion. TEST-PREVIEW has no explicit mapping. The only test checks a 3-character input, so it does not exercise the 8-character boundary, and no test covers receipt_reference.

evidence.observation: Points to the logical ID TEST-PREVIEW. No record maps it to an executable case or command.
The only assertion is preview('abc') == 'abc'. It passes for both limit 12 and limit 8, so it does not distinguish them. The file is unchanged from base.
Self-described as a 'synthetic fixture; not a real measured run', with only a compile 'passed' claim. It contains no test results.

gaps: Source S2 sources/layout.png is listed in prd-intake.json and requirements.json prd_paths but does not exist (verify-inputs reports source_unavailable). Any layout constraints for the preview label could not be reviewed.

No impact.json exists for this feature. Consumer coverage was checked independently: git grep finds src/receipt.py as the only other DISPLAY_LIMIT consumer among tracked files. Untracked or external consumers are outside the snapshot.

The exact receipt behavior to preserve is inferred from base code (truncate at 12). The PRD does not state the receipt length explicitly.
Feature status is provisional while R-1 is confirmed and decisions.json is empty. Nothing authorizes changing receipt behavior.
